categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Tongguang Electronic Wire & Cable Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: optical fiber cables, power transmission cables, and equipment cables. Their products serve the power industry, telecommunications, and military sectors, including specialized cables for aerospace and high-frequency communication applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including patented innovations in optical fiber cable manufacturing, high-frequency cables, and aerospace-grade heat-resistant cables. They utilize modern production methods such as lean manufacturing, ISO9001 quality management, and have developed proprietary technologies for low-loss, high-stability cables and energy-saving conductors. They also engage in continuous R&D collaborations with universities and research institutes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national and regional power grid companies (State Grid, Southern Grid), telecommunications operators, military and aerospace organizations, and industrial automation sectors. The company’s products are widely used in power transmission, telecommunications infrastructure, military equipment, aerospace, and industrial automation applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations and sales are predominantly domestic within China, especially concentrated in the economically developed eastern region, including Jiangsu Province. They have limited overseas sales, with a small percentage of revenue from international markets. They also have subsidiaries and investments in India and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Tongguang operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying specialized wire and cable products to downstream industries such as power utilities, telecom operators, and defense contractors. They procure raw materials like aluminum and optical fibers and convert them into finished cable products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in high-end and specialized cables, increasing R&D investment to maintain technological leadership. Strategic R&D projects include development of ultra-low loss cables, high-frequency stable cables, and advanced marine optical cables. They focus on expanding product variety, improving production efficiency, and collaborating with academic and research institutions to foster new technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized wire and cable products to large institutional customers via contracts and bidding processes. The company operates on a cost-plus pricing model, with sales based on customer orders and specifications, emphasizing product quality and technical support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic player in the specialized cable industry, recognized among the top ten competitive optical fiber cable manufacturers in China. It competes with other major cable manufacturers in the eastern region and maintains strong relationships with key state-owned enterprises. Its technological edge and quality certifications differentiate it from competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.59 billion, a 4.27% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 46.87 million, a decline of 53.36% mainly due to raw material price fluctuations and increased depreciation from capital investments. The company has total assets of about RMB 3.46 billion and employs over 1,500 staff, showing stable revenue growth but facing profitability pressure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-quality, high-end specialized cables with superior technical performance, including patented technologies and products recognized as single champion products by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. Their value proposition includes customized solutions, strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive technical support, and stable supply to critical infrastructure sectors, ensuring reliability and innovation for customers.
